map.由容量与负载电流估算可用时长。: Estimate usable runtime from capacity and load current.
map.选型时比较不同容量电池在固定负载下的续航差异。: Compare runtime differences across battery capacities at a fixed load when selecting a battery.
map.电池 3000 mAh，设备平均电流 150 mA → 续航 = 3000/15: Battery 3000 mAh, average device current 150 mA → runtime = 3000/150 = 20 h (ideal; actual is affected by self-discharge and impedance).
map.毫安时，容量单位，等于电流×小时。: Milliampere-hour, a capacity unit equal to current × hours.
map.为何实测比计算短？: Why is measured runtime shorter than calculated?
map.温度、放电倍率、截止电压与自放电都会缩短实际时长（Peukert 效应）。: Temperature, discharge rate, cutoff voltage and self-discharge all shorten actual runtime (Peukert effect).
map.电池续航计算器。科学研究工具，采用标准科学公式，计算精准。: Battery Life Calculator. A science research tool using standard scientific formulas for precise calculation.
map.P：功率（W），V：电压（V），I：电流（A）: P: power (W), V: voltage (V), I: current (A)
map.：mAh（毫安时）表示电池以1mA电流放电可持续1小时: : mAh (milliampere-hour) means the cell can supply 1 mA for 1 hour
map.：锂电池约150-350 Wh/kg，铅酸电池约30-50 Wh/kg: : Li-ion cells about 150-350 Wh/kg, lead-acid about 30-50 Wh/kg
map.：实际使用中需考虑DCDC转换效率、自放电、温度影响: : in practice, account for DC-DC conversion efficiency, self-discharge and temperature
map.：大电流放电时实际容量会降低: : usable capacity drops at high discharge currents
map.：锂电池通常3.0V截止，镍氢电池1.0V/节: : Li-ion cells typically cut off at 3.0 V, NiMH at 1.0 V per cell
map.：0°C时容量约为常温的80-90%，-20°C时约50-60%: : at 0°C capacity is about 80-90% of room temperature, at -20°C about 50-60%
map.：40°C以上会加速老化，缩短电池寿命: : above 40°C aging accelerates and service life shortens
map.：通常0-45°C，超出范围可能损坏电池: : typically 0-45°C; outside this range the cell may be damaged
